unit.brief: THE WHOLE BRIEF IS A FILE: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-supdb/2fecfb3d-3630-50b2-b9c5-2a19705f39b6/scratchpad/plan/build/T21/brief.txt. Read all of it before anything else and again before you answer; it is this change's section, and what follows here is only its outline. Stage G1 is closed (its eight units, a merge of upstream and its later rows are committed; git log says where the branch stands, scratch/plan/build/close/g1-built.md is the closing critic's account). This is the first change after it, taken from the critic's concern 4: the seal's text half (tests/source.rs, seal_check) trips on ordinary code, because its words are common ones (lent, lend, base) and its lists are keyed by a line's exact text. The change gives the seal's words names nothing else in the tree uses (the method MmapBytes::lent, the three token modules named lend and their re-exports, Paging::base and bytes::Base), each shown unique by a grep; rebuilds the source test to read each word as an identifier wherever it stands, sites named by file and scope and never by a line's text, with no rule for macros; keeps every red case of the two tests of ways round the seal red under the new names; makes the failure message say what its author is to do; and carries the names through scripts/seal-red.sh, seal-red-red.sh, the compile-fail doctests, the cost and coupling lists' keys, and the docs. No engine behaviour changes and no token's constructor or visibility widens: the count against the commit this began at is green over six probes, the wasm size is the base's. Red first: green cases of ordinary code and of rewrapped listed lines, red on today's check. Mutants named in the file and three of your own. How an agent waits, the commit this begins at, and the disk are in the file.
